subject: Day 0 kickoff: staffing, join links, and action grid
messages:
From: Asha Iyer <asha.iyer@solsticehealth.com>

Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff availability + first pass attendee list

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks again for taking this through. We’d like to lock Day 0 (kickoff) for the week of Nov 8. Attached is a first-pass attendee roster and our internal hosts (compact). Can you confirm which slot you prefer? Our constraints: PST mornings preferred, and we need an ops host + security touchpoint present.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 9, 9:30–10:30
- Wed Nov 10, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Nov 11, 9:00–10:00

Please also confirm who from Redwood will lead the onboarding run-through and who will be primary for break/fallback bridge. We’ll need the final join links for calendar invites so our SSO can pre-authorize.

Attaching: attendee-list.csv (short) — we can expand if you need a mapping to roles.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Iyer
Head of Platform Ops, Solstice Health
asha.iyer@solsticehealth.com
+1 415 555 0198

Hi Asha —

Great — thanks for the roster. Wed Nov 10 10:00–11:00 PST looks best for our ops team. We can host an optional 15-minute tech dry-run the day before (Tue Nov 9 at 16:00 PST) if you want to validate SSO and network ACLs.

Quick staffing plan from our side:
- Lead: Marissa Cole — onboarding run-through & success plan
- Ops host / bridge owner: Ben Carter — primary bridge, fallback region EU-west
- Account lead: Mina Haddad — exec sponsor intro + cadence
- Backup: Jordan Blake — will cover any escalation and assist with access requests

I’ve created a Day0 action grid and attached it (Day0-Action-Grid.xlsx) — it contains a minute-by-minute run and pre-flight checklist (SSO, data access, sample request flow). Please confirm the attendee roles in column C so we can finalize the agenda.

Also: do you have any procurement redlines we should be aware of ahead of the session (NDA / data handling callouts)? If so, loop in Eric Park and we’ll add a ten-minute compliance slot.

Best,
Mina Haddad

mina_haddad@redwood.com

Jordan: can you confirm you’re available to sit on the call as backup for infra questions?

I’ll also create a short slide that highlights post-kickoff milestones so the customer sees the 30/60/90 roadmap.
